ansatz.complete_generation: Join all 420-row Lanner tables on the three overlapping supports without heuristic pruning; test all 18 residual vertex diagrams; independently multiply by all 420 placements on the isolated boundary-of-Delta4 factor.  The archived 90 vertices are replayed as the exact Cartesian product 5x18.
ansatz.definition: Put an arbitrary order-five Lanner placement on each of the four missing five-faces, require equality on overlapping pairs, and label every other meeting pair by 2.
ansatz.symmetry_quotient: Explicit generators are checked on the complete vertex list and minimal-nonface hypergraph.  Their generated groups have orders 1440, 5760, and 4320; complete orbit traversal exports one canonical label map per orbit.

claim: For each of the ordinary-polytopal H9/14 multiwedge records 43, 44, and 47, the sparse ansatz of Lanner labels only on the four missing five-faces is locally satisfiable.  Its complete full-domain census has 12600, 60480, and 7560 labelled solutions, or 15, 25, and 5 full-nerve symmetry orbits.  Every such solution fails the global Lorentzian gate by negative index at least two.

finite_label_domain.reference: A. Burcroff, Compact hyperbolic Coxeter d-polytopes with d+4 facets and related dimension bounds, arXiv:2201.03437, Lemma 10.10
finite_label_domain.scope: the complete Burcroff domain, not the golden subalphabet
